BT22-101.effect:

[All Turns] When any of your level 4 or higher [CS] trait Digimon are deleted, by suspending this Tamer, return 1 [CS] trait Digimon card from your trash to the hand. [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When this Tamer unsuspends, if you don't have [Alphamon], this Tamer may digivolve into [Alphamon] in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
